article.title: Punishment for non-disclosure of dispute or payment of debt by operational creditor.
article.content:
76Punishment for non-disclosure of dispute or payment of debt by operational creditor.

[76. Punishment for non-disclosure of dispute or payment of debt by operational creditor.] Omitted by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Act, 2026 (6 of 2026), s. 50 (w.e.f. 26.05.2026).
